subject: Hosted API integration architecture review - scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeinc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration architecture review - intro and scheduling

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick call last week. Our engineering leads (Priya and I) would like a technical deep-dive focused on integrating Redwood's Hosted API: SDK options, streaming responses, and tool/function calling patterns.

Can we schedule a 60-75 minute session next week? Available windows on our side: Wed (7/15) 10:00-12:00 PT or Thu (7/16) 14:00-16:00 PT. If you can send a proposed agenda and who would join from your team, we'll confirm.

Alex
Alex Johnson
Senior Engineering Manager, Integrations
Acme, Inc.
alex.johnson@acmeinc.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration architecture review - proposed times & agenda

Hi Alex - great to hear from you. Wed 7/15 10:30-11:45 PT works for our team. I'll invite: myself (platform/partner lead), Dev Patel (runtime/integration engineer) and Vivek Kulkarni (solutions engineer) - Dev will cover SDK nuances and streaming, Vivek will run through function/tool calling best practices and a short demo.

Proposed agenda (60-75 mins):
- 5m: intros and success criteria
- 15m: Hosted API overview and model catalog (Marissa)
- 25m: Integration deep-dive (SDKs, streaming, batching) (Dev)
- 20m: Tool/function calling + demo + Q&A (Vivek)
- 10m: next steps (Mutual action items / POC scope)

I've attached a short architecture deck and an editable agenda doc - feel free to add items. I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm the time.

Attachments: Redwood_HostedAPI_Architecture_Deck.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB); agenda-hosted-api-deep-dive.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Partner Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeinc.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeinc.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration architecture review - quick note about infra

Hey team - quick note from engineering: for our POC we'd like to validate streaming with server-sent events behind our proxy and confirm function calling semantics for our toolchain (we use a mix of internal webhooks and a lightweight task runner). Also, we'll need to confirm acceptable auth flows (API key vs mTLS).

I'll add a short doc to the shared drive with our proxy topology and a list of sample endpoints.

- Priya
Priya Shah
Staff Engineer, Platform
Acme, Inc.
priya.shah@acmeinc.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeinc.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 07:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration architecture review - reschedule request

Hi Alex / Priya - heads up: Dev (our lead for SDKs/streaming) has a high-priority incident that morning and asked if we can move the session by 90 minutes. Would Thu 7/16 15:30-16:45 PT work instead of Wed? If that blocks you, we can keep Wed and have Vivek cover more of the streaming parts and schedule a follow-up 30-minute deep-dive with Dev.

I've copied Rachel from Sales Ops so she can handle calendar invites and recording permissions.

Calendar invite (proposed): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-hosted-api-deep-dive
Drive notes: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2B3C4D5E6F7G8H/view?usp=sharing

Marissa

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeinc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeinc.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration architecture review - confirmed Thu 7/16 15:30 PT

Thanks - Thu 7/16 15:30-16:45 PT works for us. We'll plan for the full 75 minutes. Please include a brief pre-reqs section (auth, proxy notes) in the agenda so our infra folks can skim before the call.

Confirmed attendees on our side: Alex Johnson, Priya Shah, and Ben Torres (platform engineer).

See you then - Alex
